## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 36. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

The guide explains the hire's logic through Auburn's scoring problem — 18.5 and 19.1 PPG against SEC opponents over two seasons — and Golesh's profile as an offensive coach who has spent his entire collegiate career on that side of the ball. It traces the path: four seasons under Matt Campbell, three under Josh Heupel, then 23-15 in his first head-coaching job at South Florida. With the defense in the hands of veterans DJ Durkin and Tim Banks, it says Golesh's chief objective is to find points, something he has done pretty much everywhere. Its stated condition is how the USF transfers adapt to Power Four life, quarterback Byrum Brown included.
